remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Inscription dates 1916. Dated. c. 1915/1916 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977.

credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Vertical charcoal drawing on paper with curving lines that sweep from top right to bottom lower left.  One quite small dark half moon shape in middle right, while other shades are lighter greyish.
